<title level="1" right="Class Feature 13">[Eidolon Unarmed Mastery](/Classes.aspx?ID=18)</title>

<column gap="tiny">
**Source** [Secrets of Magic](/Sources.aspx?ID=96) pg. 51

**Class** Summoner
</column>

---

Your eidolon truly masters its unarmed attacks, reaching greater heights. Its proficiency rank for unarmed attacks increases to master.
